DIAGNOSIS READY: Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma

The patient reports early satiety and weight loss (clothes fitting tighter) without respiratory symptoms like cough, which makes active pulmonary tuberculosis less likely despite the constitutional symptoms and lymphadenopathy. We have already ordered a Complete Blood Count and inflammatory markers; the results from these will be critical to distinguish between lymphoma, leukemia, or other systemic malignancies. I will wait for the lab results to finalize the workup before considering a biopsy or further imaging.
